claims.claim: Cleanly used Electric bike for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows intact paint and no visible damage, but 'cleanly used' implies mechanical/battery condition which the photo cannot confirm.
No battery label, compartment, or spec plate visible in the photo; battery type and capacity cannot be confirmed from the image.

risks.risk: Battery health and real capacity may be degraded or mismatched to claimed 72v 20ah spec
risks.proof: Close-up photo of battery label/serial plus a video of voltage/charge test under load
risks.if_unproven: price as weak/near end-of-life lead acid battery

risks.risk: Unknown mileage and age of scooter and battery
risks.proof: Photo of odometer/dashboard display and any purchase/warranty document with date
Photo showing keys, charger, and ownership documents together with the scooter
risks.if_unproven: price as incomplete set, no accessories included

risks.proof: Short video of the scooter being ridden or at least powered on and moving
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified mechanical condition, assume needs servicing

risks.risk: Identity/brand/model unknown, affects parts availability and resale value
risks.proof: Clear photo of nameplate, VIN, or brand logo on body panel

risks.risk: Tire and brake wear not inspectable from a single angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires and brake pads/discs
risks.if_unproven: price assuming tires/brakes need replacement soon

proof_requests: Clear photo of battery label/spec plate
Video of scooter starting and running, showing speed/odometer if present
Photo of keys, charger, and any documents together with the unit
Close-up photos of tires and brakes from multiple angles
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an electric scooter in apparently intact external condition, so it can be priced at worst case for battery, mileage, and completeness until further proof is supplied.
